Bench: Vishal Dhagat

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur

 (Prabhu Dayal Gangele Vs The State Of Madhya Pr
 Dated : 11-12-2024
 Shri Sunil Kumar Mishra - Advocate for the petitioner
 Shri Narendra Kumar Sharma - Advocate for respondent 
Shri Lalit Joglekar - Government Advocate for the State.
Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India making a prayer to
quash Fir registered against petitioner at Police Station-Bhagwa, District-Chatarpur (Mp) in
connection with Crime No.268/2023 for offences punishable under Sections 365, 376, 376(2)(E),
376(2)(n), 450, 34, 506 of the Ipc.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that police after completing the investigation has written a letter to remove the name of petitioner from the charge sheet as no offence appears to have been committed by him.
After writing letter to Superintendent of Police dated 08.02.2024, no further action has been taken.
No supplementary charge sheet has been filed against him.

Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State prays for some time to seek instruction whether any closure report has been filed against petitioner and if investigation is completed against him or not.
List the matter in week commencing 27.01.2025.
